note: Adapted from Chhotani's (1997) species description; the original is in English. The alate, previously unknown for the species, is described for the first time from new specimens; the soldier and worker are based on Indian specimens; distribution records, synonymic citations, type information and figure numbers are not included.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier body length 5.3–7.0 mm, head capsule 1.57–1.65 times as long as wide, frontal inclination 50°–60°, left mandible twisted in the middle with a weak beak at the apex, the inner margin of the right mandibular apex strongly incurved into a point, the postmentum rod-shaped with the waist below the middle; alate head capsule nearly circular, compound eyes circular, pronotum nearly trapezoidal, fore wing 10.2–11.10 mm long.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown; antennae pale brown; left mandible nearly black, right mandible reddish brown; legs pale yellow; body creamy white. Head sparsely hairy, body densely hairy. Body length 5.3–7.0 mm. Head capsule nearly rectangular, 1.57–1.65 times as long as wide, length with mandibles 3.6–3.80 mm, length to the base of the mandibles 1.85–2.10 mm, maximum width 1.15–1.30 mm; sides nearly straight, slightly narrowed anteriorly; frons weakly to rather strongly inclined forwards, the inclination 50°–60°; anterior lateral corners weakly to distinctly projecting forwards as tubercles; coronal suture extending to slightly below the middle. Fontanelle transverse; fontanelle gland rather large, extending slightly beyond the middle of the head. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 subequal. Labrum asymmetrical, narrow and elongate, anterior margin deeply incurved; lateral margins with small serrations. Mandibles slightly shorter than the head (without mandibles) to as long as the head, left mandible 1.50–2.10 mm, right mandible 1.5–1.70 mm, index (left mandible length / head length without mandibles) 0.80–1.00. Left mandible twisted in the middle, with a weak beak at the apex, the beak sometimes broken and not apparent; right mandible slightly shorter than the left, the outer and inner margins weakly incurved in the apical half, the inner margin of the apex strongly incurved and the tip prolonged into a point. Postmentum rod-shaped, the waist below the middle, length 0.75–0.95 mm, maximum width 0.30–0.375 mm, waist width 0.13–0.20 mm. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, length 0.20–0.35 mm, width 0.55–0.75 mm; anterior lobe semicircular with a weak notch, posterior margin without a notch.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule and postclypeus pale yellowish brown; antennae, legs and thorax creamy white; abdomen transparent. Head and body rather densely hairy. Head nearly circular, length to the tip of the labrum 1.18–1.30 mm, length to the base of the mandibles 0.75–0.90 mm, maximum width 0.93–1.05 mm. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus strongly convex and hairy, about half as long as wide, length 0.23–0.26 mm, width 0.45–0.50 mm. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, length 0.20–0.25 mm, width 0.50–0.60 mm; anterior and posterior margins without a notch.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark reddish brown; antennae, postclypeus and pronotum brown; abdominal tergites reddish brown, sternites brown with the middle yellowish brown; wings pale brown, transparent. Head and body densely covered with short microsetae and some longer setae; wing margins hairy, the membrane with a few hairs as well. Body length with wings 12.70–13.30 mm, without wings about 7.00–7.50 mm. Head capsule nearly circular, length to the tip of the labrum 1.25–1.30 mm, length to the base of the mandibles 0.80–0.83 mm, width including the eyes 1.15–1.17 mm, interocular width 0.85–0.90 mm; head not depressed around the fontanelle; fontanelle plate elongate-oval, length 0.08 mm, width 0.04 mm. Antennae 14–15-segmented; in the 14-segmented condition segment 3 is longer than segment 2 and sometimes in the process of dividing; in the 15-segmented condition segment 3 is very short. Compound eyes circular, maximum diameter 0.28 mm, minimum diameter 0.25–0.28 mm; about 1/5 of its diameter from the lower margin of the head, that is 0.05–0.06 mm, and 0.05–0.07 mm from the antennae. Ocelli broadly elliptical, length 0.125–0.15 mm, width 0.10 mm; separated from the eye by less than their width, 0.08 mm, and from the antennae by about their width, 0.10–0.12 mm. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal, length 0.53–0.55 mm, width 0.88–1.00 mm; middle of the anterior margin slightly projecting with a weak notch; middle of the posterior margin slightly incurved. Wing surface with papillate tubercles and microsetae; fore wing 10.2–11.10 mm long, hind wing 9.7–10.4 mm.
